extraction_notes: Only the main article text/images were provided; Supporting Information tables/figures (including Table S5 and Figures S20–S22) were not available for extraction. Figure 4b temperature-dependence curves and Figure 4c stability curves contain additional plotted points, but the small overlapping symbols and low-resolution image make many individual values/times unreliable; only exact text values and the clearer plots/bars were extracted. Literature-comparison values in Figure 4d and cited BaTiO2.5H0.5 data were not extracted.
